description: Fix implementation divergences from documentation: regex.replace argument order, datetime.parse format tokens, session.csrf() idempotency, math functions returning int where appropriate, and request.form() parsing
steps: Fix regex.replace in src/builtins/builtins.c: docs say regex.replace(pattern, subject, replacement) but code reads args as (pattern, replacement, subject). Change to match docs: args[0]=pattern, args[1]=subject, args[2]=replacement. The fallback return should also be updated from args[2] to args[1].

Fix datetime.parse in src/builtins/builtins.c: docs say format uses YYYY-MM-DD tokens (like datetime.format), but implementation passes format directly to strptime (C format). Add token conversion before calling strptime: replace YYYY with %Y, YY with %y, MM with %m, DD with %d, HH with %H, mm with %M, ss with %S. This makes datetime.parse consistent with datetime.format.

Fix session.csrf() in src/builtins/builtins.c: docs say 'creates token on first call per session and returns it; subsequent calls return the same token'. Current code always generates a new random token. Fix: check if _csrf key already exists in session_data and return it if so, only generate a new one if missing.

Fix math builtins (floor, ceil, round, min, max) in src/builtins/builtins.c: they always return eka_number() (double) but should return eka_int() when the result is a whole number that fits in 46 bits. This matches the general Eka convention documented in LANGUAGE.md ('Whole numbers that fit in 46 bits are stored as int').

Implement request.form() in src/builtins/builtins.c: currently returns empty map always. Parse application/x-www-form-urlencoded body from vm->current_req->body into key-value map. Use the same URL-decoding logic already present in request_query. Handle + as space, %XX as hex byte.

Update tests in tests/test_builtins.c: add tests for (a) regex.replace with correct arg order, (b) datetime.parse with YYYY-MM-DD format, (c) session.csrf() idempotency (call twice, same token returned), (d) math.floor returning int, (e) request.form() parsing a POST body.
acceptance_criteria: regex.replace('foo', 'foo bar', 'baz') returns 'baz bar' (pattern, subject, replacement order)
datetime.parse('2024-01-15', 'YYYY-MM-DD') returns a map with year=2024, month=1, day=15
session.csrf() called twice on same session returns the same token string
math.floor(3.0) returns eka_int(3), math.min(10, 3) returns eka_int(3)
All existing tests continue to pass
New tests pass for all fixed builtins
